selection_summary: The original MIT perching-glider observations are documented in publications but were not found as a publicly downloadable, machine-readable dataset with a data license and immutable file metadata. The selected fallback is an authoritative CC0 flight-test dataset created specifically for system identification of a fixed-wing Skywalker X8 UAV. It has synchronized input/output time series, an explicit 40 Hz timebase, documented fields and units, immutable per-file checksums, and a creator-defined training/validation split. Selection is conditional on replacing perching-, stall-, and flat-plate-specific computed claims with claims about the Skywalker X8's ordinary longitudinal excitation maneuvers and measured variables.

preflights_read_first.finding_used: B1 requires original numeric observations with verified redistribution rights and full field, unit, time, version, and split provenance; MIT plot pixels may not be digitized.
The routed MIT artifacts are measured rasters only and cannot support a recurrence fit, held-out RMSE, residual ACF, sample-time claim, or fitted pole.

selected_candidate.title: System identification campaign - Skywalker X8 UAV

license.name: CC0 1.0 Universal
license.credit_expectation: Although CC0 does not condition reuse on attribution, DataverseNO community norms and good scientific practice request citation of the dataset. Preserve the generated data citation and DOI.

download_size.size_note: The recommended lesson download is the nine longitudinal CSV files only. The minimum pair is enough to demonstrate a predeclared train/validation workflow, but all nine longitudinal maneuvers provide a better evidence base while remaining small.

dataset_design.vehicle: Skywalker X8 small fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle
dataset_design.environment_warning: The repository documents strong north-west wind with a significant vertical component. Do not interpret a low-order fitted recurrence as an invariant aircraft model.

time_and_sampling.index_convention: Each maneuver is a separate ordered record. CSV row 1 is sample n=0 at t=0; increment n by one per row and do not concatenate maneuver boundaries as if dynamically continuous.
time_and_sampling.source_processing: Three sources were manually synchronized and resampled to 40 Hz. STIM300 IMU was downsampled from 200 Hz; GPS and propulsion data were upsampled from 10 Hz; SBC control commands were originally 40 Hz.
time_and_sampling.known_alignment_limit: The README warns that manual synchronization of SBC input commands can affect computed actuator time delay. Delay claims must therefore be qualified and sensitivity-tested.

csv_contract.missing_value_policy: Do not impute or bridge across maneuver boundaries. Abort on a nonnumeric token or a row other than 41 fields; report any exclusion by file and row. The scout's complete stream scan of all nine longitudinal CSV files found no empty field and no case-insensitive NaN, null, or NA token in 3,828 rows.
csv_contract.privacy_note: GPS longitude and latitude are present. If the course does not need location, omit those columns from the derived lesson CSV while preserving the unmodified source checksum and documenting the projection.

chronological_fit_and_holdout_assessment.split_to_use: Use only the repository's interoperability_files/training/longitudinal_*.csv files for estimator and model-order choices. Freeze preprocessing, lag, and order before opening the two interoperability_files/validation/longitudinal_*.csv files. Preserve row order within every maneuver and reset lag state at each file boundary.
chronological_fit_and_holdout_assessment.recommended_introductory_model: A declared low-order discrete ARX recurrence for pitch rate, for example q[n] from past q and elevator samples, with order and any delay selected using training files only. This is a proposed teaching model, not a repository-supplied or prevalidated equation.
chronological_fit_and_holdout_assessment.baseline: Use an input-free autoregressive or persistence/trim baseline, not flat-plate lift/drag theory. Report one-step and free-run validation separately.
validation_guardrails: Do not pool rows across maneuver boundaries without resetting state.
Do not choose model order, delay, filters, outputs, or plot windows after inspecting validation residuals.
Do not call the validation records a contiguous final 20 percent block; they are separate predesignated maneuvers.
Treat the strong wind and manual input synchronization as concrete idealization limits.
Report both per-maneuver and aggregate metrics so a long file cannot silently dominate.

access_commands.note: The CSV files intentionally have no header row; assign names from the 41-position README contract before analysis.

candidates.title: Experiments in Fixed-Wing UAV Perching / Supermaneuverable Perching experimental records
candidates.authority: MIT CSAIL Robot Locomotion Group; Rick Cory and Russ Tedrake
candidates.what_was_verified: The papers document real motion-capture flight data, elevator commands, derived angle of attack/lift/drag/moment coefficients, and perching trials. The 2008 paper defines variables and describes filtering/differentiation, but publishes plots and methodology rather than a raw machine-readable record.
rejection_reasons: No authoritative public CSV, MAT, repository deposit, data API, or raw-record download was found from the MIT publication/project surfaces inspected.
No standalone license for the underlying numeric observations was found.
The paper PDFs and MIT OCW raster license cannot be assumed to license unpublished numeric records for redistribution.
There is no immutable raw-data version or checksum to preserve.
Plot digitization is explicitly forbidden by the lesson preflight.
candidates.reconsider_if: The creators or MIT publish the original records in a repository with an explicit data license, field/unit/time documentation, and immutable file metadata.

candidates.title: System identification campaign - Skywalker X8 UAV
selection_reasons: CC0 explicitly permits redistribution and derived plots

candidates.title: Longitudinal Motion System Identification of a Fixed-Wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Using Limited Unplanned Flight Data
candidates.authority: Peer-reviewed Aerospace article by Nuno M. B. Matos and André C. Marta
candidates.what_was_verified: The article applies time-domain identification to pitch, altitude, airspeed, and pitch-rate responses from a medium fixed-wing UAV and is highly relevant methodologically.
rejection_reasons: No authoritative raw-data landing page or directly downloadable flight record was identified from the article and searches inspected.
No raw-data license, version, checksum, or machine-readable field/time contract could be verified.
An open-access article license does not by itself establish redistribution rights for an unattached underlying dataset.

candidates.title: DASHlink Sample Flight Data
candidates.what_was_verified: The landing page exposes actual regional-jet recorded data, including MATLAB downloads and a 186-parameter structure, for public aviation-safety data-mining research.
rejection_reasons: The landing page gives a purpose-specific public-use statement but no exact standard data license was found that clearly authorizes redistribution in a bundled course and publication of derived plots.
The records are operational approach data, not declared excitation maneuvers for input/output system identification.
Control-input identity, units, alignment, validation split, immutable dataset version, and per-file checksum were not all established from the landing surface.
It is a regional jet rather than a glider or small UAV, requiring a larger scope rewrite than the selected dataset.

candidates.title: Fixed-Wing UAS Telemetry Benchmark (IDF_DS): 240 Flights for ML and Intelligent Trajectory Optimization
candidates.what_was_verified: The record is public, versioned, checksummed, licensed CC BY 4.0, and contains wide per-flight CSV telemetry for 240 fixed-wing UAS flights.
rejection_reasons: The only published download units are two monolithic archives totaling 2,702,777,878 bytes, so a small-file schema and signal sample could not be inspected without a disproportionate download.
The stated benchmark purposes are telemetry ML and trajectory optimization, not controlled longitudinal excitation/system identification.
No creator-defined chronological training/validation maneuver split for input/output identification was verified from the record metadata.
It is more than 400 times larger than the selected dataset's complete source contents and materially less focused on the lesson.

candidates.title: System Identification for Small Flying-Wing Unmanned Aircraft Using Open-Loop and Closed-Loop Flight Data
candidates.authority: NASA Langley/University of Kansas research; Journal of Aircraft article and engrXiv preprint
candidates.what_was_verified: The work directly demonstrates longitudinal open-loop system identification on a small flying-wing UAS and is an excellent methodological match.
rejection_reasons: No authoritative public raw-flight-data deposit or direct machine-readable data download was discovered from the paper/preprint surfaces inspected.
No raw-data license, field/unit/time metadata, immutable dataset version, or file checksum could be verified.
The publication is a method source, not a redistributable numeric dataset.

proposed_lesson_scope_changes.new_application_title: Longitudinal system identification from Skywalker X8 UAV flight tests
proposed_lesson_scope_changes.retain_from_mit_perching_case: Retain the rights-cleared MIT perching images only as contextual motivation for why flight models can fail outside familiar regimes. Clearly state that the course's computation uses a different vehicle and dataset and makes no numerical comparison to the MIT glider.

replace_claims.remove: The fitted/recomputed data are measurements from the MIT perching glider.
replace_claims.replace_with: The fitted/recomputed data are 40 Hz flight-test records from the NTNU Skywalker X8 fixed-wing UAV.

replace_claims.remove: A flat-plate lift/drag baseline is evaluated against measured coefficient samples.
replace_claims.replace_with: An input-free persistence or autoregressive baseline is compared with a low-order elevator-to-pitch-response ARX recurrence.

replace_claims.remove: The held-out segment is a stall/high-angle-of-attack perching region.
replace_claims.replace_with: The holdout consists of the repository's predesignated longitudinal validation maneuvers; discuss excitation-family and wind-related distribution shift without labeling a stall region.

replace_claims.remove: The course validated a perching trajectory or perching-specific recurrence.
replace_claims.replace_with: The course evaluated one-step and free-run longitudinal response prediction on ordinary Skywalker X8 system-identification maneuvers.

replace_claims.remove: A fixed 20 percent held-out RMSE improvement is an empirical success claim.
replace_claims.replace_with: Freeze the model and comparison protocol before validation, then report the measured improvement or degradation honestly. If a 20 percent value remains, label it a precommitted design target, not a known result.

recommended_teaching_signal_pair.reason: Elevator-to-pitch-rate is a direct longitudinal input/output relationship with visible excitation and avoids pretending the dataset contains lift/drag coefficients.

proposed_lesson_scope_changes.figure_4_rewrite: Replace 'Glider residual diagnostics by angle-of-attack/stall region' with 'Skywalker X8 longitudinal validation residuals by time and excitation maneuver.' Plot source-derived signals only after a deterministic script fixes model order and split. Label per-file boundaries and distinguish 3211 from doublet validation.
proposed_lesson_scope_changes.exercise_rewrite: Have learners assign the README's header contract, verify t increments, fit a training-only low-order recurrence, evaluate both designated validation maneuvers without tuning, compare one-step versus free-run error, and name wind/manual synchronization as threats to interpretation.
proposed_lesson_scope_changes.data_asset_note: Do not name a derived file perching-flight.csv. Use a vehicle-accurate name such as skywalker-x8-longitudinal.csv or keep one file per maneuver so state resets remain explicit.
claims_still_blocked: Any numerical claim about the MIT perching glider beyond the cited publication artifacts
Any computed lift/drag coefficient comparison or flat-plate residual from this dataset
Any statement that the selected validation flights enter a documented stall or perching regime
Any exact actuator-delay claim that ignores the README's manual synchronization warning
Any claimed validation threshold not yet recomputed by a frozen, reproducible course script
